title: MADR import ships deterministic: file-path ids, honest bi-temporal windows, fail-safe topic anchoring
context: Import half of the private MADR-bridge roadmap (dec_ce410d9a6d). ADR-practicing repos previously got zero day-1 value — backfill only mines commits. Shipped in commit aa06ecc as src/extractors/adrImport.ts + `hunch import-adr`.
decision: Parse MADR 3.x/4 frontmatter style AND Nygard heading style with one pure section-based parser (no markdown dependency, no LLM). Mapping: accepted→live; superseded/deprecated→status superseded with valid_to closed at the successor's date; rejected→rejected; Considered Options minus the chosen option→alternatives_rejected; NNNN-slug.md slug→topic `adr.<slug>` (namespaced). Ids derive from the repo-relative file path (decisionId("madr:<relPath>")) so re-import is an idempotent per-record update. Cross-links resolve by ADR number within the imported corpus only; a one-sided "Superseded by" derives the successor's supersedes pointer. Provenance source "imported:madr", confidence 0.75, the ADR file as evidence.
consequences: A superseded ADR with no date anywhere keeps an OPEN valid_to — the v2-migration precedent (never fabricate an instant); status carries the truth.
The CLI drops a topic anchor (imports the record un-anchored, with a warning) when the graph already holds a live decision on that topic — an import can never create a second live decision per topic.
Within one corpus, two live ADRs on the same topic collapse deterministically: highest ADR number stays live, the rest close against it.

Imported records are advisory-tier by provenance (imported:madr, 0.75) — they ground and retrieve but never gain blocking authority without human attestation, per the existing human-signature discipline.
Export half (`hunch export --madr` + Backstage annotation) remains on the private roadmap decision.
alternatives_rejected: A markdown-parsing dependency (remark/marked): the section grammar ADRs actually use is a dozen lines of line-based parsing; a parser dependency adds supply-chain surface to a deterministic extractor for no fidelity gain.
Fabricating valid_to from import time when no date exists: pollutes as-of queries with an instant that never happened; the migration layer already chose open-window honesty for exactly this case.

Importing topics un-namespaced (slug as topic): a corpus slug like "auth" could collide with a live hand-captured topic and either get rejected wholesale or contest authority; the adr. namespace plus the live-topic drop makes import unconditionally safe.
LLM enrichment at import time: breaks the no-model-in-the-loop determinism contract for the write path; enrichment can be layered later as an explicitly separate advisory pass.
